items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: I would like to have heard that Adam Mule dance, anyhow, whether it was worth putting on or not to know, because he played some very fine piano, as you know, from that one in the library.

ctx.x: We're talking about those General Records and then... The General made, the General Records. Yeah. Well, there were some that were not issued, as you know. Yeah, those... Sporting House and...

Sporting House. I would like to have heard that Adam Mule dance, anyhow, whether it was worth putting on or not to know, because he played some very fine piano, as you know, from that one in the library.
Yeah, that's one that's never played much, you know. That's one of the better ones he did.
